listing.name: Fleet Storage Filter
listing.summary: Got too many ships? Search through your hoard to find what you need.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a search filter to the fleet storage list to help find specific ships.

description:
Fleet Storage Filter

Direct Download Latest

Source Code (Github)

Description

Got too many ships? Search through your hoard to find what you need.

Showcase (v2.0.0)

https://vimeo.com/1108444256

Safe to install/uninstall from existing saves
Requires MagicLib, LunaLib

Changelog

Spoiler
v2.0.1
Search is now case-insensitive and matches with hull name instead of internal id (thanks EnigmaniteZ)

v2.1.0
Moved the location of the search bar to not overlap with UI (thanks JamesTripleQ)
Search now uses fuzzy string matching, threshold might need tweaking
This version adds LunaLib as a dependency to enable the above
Version checker integration (tell me if its broken :P)

v2.1.1
LunaSettings integration for configuring fuzzy search threshold, search bar UI position
Fixed a storage list sorting bug

v2.1.1a
fixed an issue in the previous version

v2.1.1b
hotfix to restore previous sort behaviour

v2.1.1c
fixed sorting behaviour in non storage fleets

Credits

Genir: wrote the original mod and let me take over
Lukas04: code I referenced from LunaLib and Second in Command

aiDescription: Adds a search bar to the fleet storage interface. It supports case-insensitive and fuzzy string matching to help locate ships in large fleets. The search threshold and UI position can be configured via settings.
